Subject: Orchid Capital demo — post-call compliance recap and evidence checklist

Hi Asha / Ben,

Thanks again for your time earlier — appreciated the honest dialogue about the operational constraints you're seeing with your current vendor. Quick recap from our side and concrete next steps so your InfoSec and procurement teams can plan.

Pain points you flagged (summary):
- Necessity for a Type II SOC 2 report covering both hosted and any dedicated/private deployment.
- Audit log retention: want event-level audit trails retained for 13 months with exportable CSVs.
- Data residency & DPA redlines (esp. liability and subprocessors).
- Pen test scope and timing before production go-live.

What we committed to deliver by next week (initial evidence packet):
1) SOC 2 artifact checklist and sample report (placeholder) — SOC2-asklist.xlsx (attachment).
2) Retention mapping template — retention-table.csv (attachment).
3) DPA redline (initial) — we will upload a mark-up for your legal review (dpa-redline-v1.docx).
4) Draft pen-test scope for your review (pen-test-scope.pdf).

Proposed timing:
- Wednesday 2026-09-22: send SOC2 extract + retention mapping.
- Friday 2026-10-01: share finalized pen-test scope and proposed windows (we recommend a non-prod window Oct 5–9).
- Please let us know your legal counterparty for the DPA review — we can queue a DocuSign room.

Immediate asks for you (so we can size the evidence):
- Confirm whether 13 months retention is the absolute minimum or flexible.
- Share the contact for procurement/legal who will own DPA redline.
- If you have an internal IP allowlist for pen tests, send the IP ranges.

Attachments: SOC2-asklist.xlsx (stub), retention-table.csv (stub), dpa-redline-v1.docx (stub), pen-test-scope.pdf (stub).

If helpful, Jordan and I can run a short follow-up with your security lead next week for walk-through.

Best,
Irene Choi
